hero: From shopfront signs to staff uniforms, Print Garage helps Kampala businesses get their branding made. Bring us your artwork, quantities and ideas for print, clothing and promotional items that suit your next project.
about:
Print Garage is a branding and printing company that offers quality services in commercial printing, PPE supplies, office supplies and promotional items. We are a trusted innovator and industry leader, with unique delivery criteria and breakthrough offers such as discounts for our enrolled clients in accordance with competitive market prices and much more.

Print Garage also offers different service packages for businesses and organisations to promote brand visibility.
mission: To provide unique, timely and professional branding services for better customer experience.
vision: To be a one stop center providing exceptional services.
purpose: Help organisations look consistent wherever people meet them: at their premises, on their team and in the items they share.
partners: Recognising the businesses and organisations in our partner community.
